items.source:
A TransactionManager is necessary for suspending and resuming transactions,
as this not supported by the UserTransaction interface.
items.translation: 事务管理器对于挂起和恢复事务是必要的，因为用户事务接口不支持此功能。

items.source:
Note that the TransactionManager will be autodetected if the JTA
UserTransaction object implements the JTA TransactionManager interface too,
as well as autodetected at various well-known fallback JNDI locations.
items.translation: 请注意，如果 JTA UserTransaction 对象也实现了 JTA TransactionManager 接口，则事务管理器将自动检测；此外，它还会在各种众所周知的备用 JNDI 位置进行自动检测。

items.source: Typically false. Checked by AbstractMessageEndpointFactory in order to differentiate between invalid configuration and valid ResourceAdapter-managed transactions.
items.translation: 通常为 `false`。由 AbstractMessageEndpointFactory 检查，以区分无效配置和资源适配器管理的交易。

items.source: This pure JtaTransactionManager class supports timeouts but not per-transaction isolation levels. Custom subclasses may override the doJtaBegin(JtaTransactionObject, TransactionDefinition) method for specific JTA extensions in order to provide this functionality. Such adapters for specific Jakarta EE transaction coordinators may also expose transaction names for monitoring; with standard JTA, transaction names will simply be ignored.
items.translation: 该类纯 `JtaTransactionManager` 支持超时，但不支持每事务隔离级别。自定义子类可以重写 doJtaBegin(JtaTransactionObject, TransactionDefinition) 方法以针对特定的 JTA 扩展提供此功能。此类特定于 Jakarta EE 事务协调器的适配器还可以暴露事务名称以供监控；对于标准 JTA，事务名称将被直接忽略。

items.source: To be called after initUserTransactionAndTransactionManager(), since it may check the UserTransaction and TransactionManager handles.
items.translation: 在调用initUserTransactionAndTransactionManager()之后进行调用，因为它可能会检查 UserTransaction 和 TransactionManager 句柄。

items.source: To be overridden in subclasses for specific JTA implementations, as alternative to overriding the full doJtaBegin(JtaTransactionObject, TransactionDefinition) method.
items.translation: 需在子类中重写，以针对特定的 JTA 实现提供替代方案，避免重写完整的 doJtaBegin(JtaTransactionObject, TransactionDefinition) 方法。

items.source: For typical JTA transactions (REQUIRED, SUPPORTS, MANDATORY, NEVER), a plain JtaTransactionManager definition is all you need, portable across all Jakarta EE servers. This corresponds to the functionality of the JTA UserTransaction, for which Jakarta EE specifies a standard JNDI name ("java:comp/UserTransaction"). There is no need to configure a server-specific TransactionManager lookup for this kind of JTA usage.
items.translation: 对于典型的 JTA 事务（REQUIRED、SUPPORTS、MANDATORY、NEVER），只需一个普通的 JtaTransactionManager 定义即可，该定义可在所有 Jakarta EE 服务器之间移植。这对应于 JTA UserTransaction 的功能，而 Jakarta EE 为其指定了标准的 JNDI 名称（"java:comp/UserTransaction"）。对于此类 JTA 用法，无需配置特定于服务器的 TransactionManager 查找。

items.source: Transaction suspension (REQUIRES_NEW, NOT_SUPPORTED) is just available with a JTA TransactionManager being registered. Common TransactionManager locations are autodetected by JtaTransactionManager, provided that the "autodetectTransactionManager" flag is set to "true" (which it is by default).
items.translation: 事务挂起（REQUIRES_NEW、NOT_SUPPORTED）仅在注册了 JTA TransactionManager 时可用。 只要将 "autodetectTransactionManager" 标志设置为 "true"（默认即为 true），JtaTransactionManager 即可自动检测常见的 TransactionManager 位置。

items.source: Called by afterPropertiesSet if no direct UserTransaction reference was set. Can be overridden in subclasses to provide a different UserTransaction object.
items.translation: 由afterPropertiesSet调用，如果未设置直接的 UserTransaction 引用。可以在子类中重写此方法以提供不同的 UserTransaction 对象。

items.source: Called by afterPropertiesSet if no direct TransactionManager reference was set. Can be overridden in subclasses to provide a different TransactionManager object.
items.translation: 由afterPropertiesSet调用，如果未设置直接的 TransactionManager 引用。可以在子类中重写它以提供不同的 TransactionManager 对象。

items.source: JTA implementations might support nested transactions via further UserTransaction.begin() invocations, but never support savepoints.
items.translation: JTA 实现可能通过进一步的 `UserTransaction.begin()` 调用支持嵌套事务，但永远不支持保存点。

items.source: The default implementation simply invokes the afterCompletion methods immediately, passing in "STATUS_UNKNOWN". This is the best we can do if there's no chance to determine the actual outcome of the outer transaction.
items.translation: 默认实现会立即调用afterCompletion方法，并传入"STATUS_UNKNOWN"。如果无法确定外部事务的实际结果，这是我们能做的最好的了。

items.source:
This transaction manager is appropriate for handling distributed transactions,
i.e. transactions that span multiple resources, and for controlling transactions on
application server resources (for example, JDBC DataSources available in JNDI) in general.
For a single JDBC DataSource, DataSourceTransactionManager is perfectly sufficient,
and for accessing a single resource with Hibernate (including transactional cache),
HibernateTransactionManager is appropriate, for example.
items.translation: 此事务管理器适用于处理分布式事务，即跨越多个资源的事务，以及通常用于控制应用程序服务器资源上的事务（例如 JNDI 中可用的 JDBC DataSource）。对于单个 JDBC DataSource，DataSourceTransactionManager 已完全足够；而对于访问单个 Hibernate 资源（包括事务缓存）等场景，HibernateTransactionManager 则是合适的选择。

items.source:
Note: Support for the JTA TransactionManager interface is not required by Jakarta EE.
Almost all Jakarta EE servers expose it, but do so as extension to EE. There might be some
issues with compatibility, despite the TransactionManager interface being part of JTA.
items.translation: 注意：Jakarta EE 并不要求支持 JTA TransactionManager 接口。几乎所有 Jakarta EE 服务器都提供该接口，但它是作为对 EE 的扩展提供的。尽管 TransactionManager 接口是 JTA 的一部分，但仍可能存在一些兼容性问题。

items.source:
JTA 1.1 adds the TransactionSynchronizationRegistry facility, as public Jakarta EE
API in addition to the standard JTA UserTransaction handle. As of Spring 2.5, this
JtaTransactionManager autodetects the TransactionSynchronizationRegistry and uses
it for registering Spring-managed synchronizations when participating in an existing
JTA transaction (for example, controlled by EJB CMT). If no TransactionSynchronizationRegistry
is available, then such synchronizations will be registered via the (non-EE) JTA
TransactionManager handle.
items.translation: JTA 1.1 增加了 `TransactionSynchronizationRegistry` 设施，作为公共 Jakarta EE API，除了标准的 JTA `UserTransaction` 句柄之外。从 Spring 2.5 开始，此 `JtaTransactionManager` 会自动检测 `TransactionSynchronizationRegistry`，并在参与现有的 JTA 事务（例如由 EJB CMT 控制）时，使用它来注册由 Spring 管理的同步操作。如果不可用 `TransactionSynchronizationRegistry`，则将通过 (非 EE) JTA `TransactionManager` 句柄注册此类同步操作。

items.source: This class is serializable. However, active synchronizations do not survive serialization.
items.translation: 该类是可序列化的。但是，活动同步不会在序列化后保留。

items.source:
Typically just used for local JTA setups; in a Jakarta EE environment,
the UserTransaction will always be fetched from JNDI.
items.translation: 通常仅用于本地 JTA 设置；在 Jakarta EE 环境中，UserTransaction 总是从 JNDI 获取。

items.source:
Note that the UserTransaction will be autodetected at the Jakarta EE
default location "java:comp/UserTransaction" if not specified explicitly.
items.translation: 请注意，如果未显式指定，UserTransaction 将在 Jakarta EE 默认位置 "java:comp/UserTransaction" 处被自动检测。

items.source:
Default is "true", autodetecting the UserTransaction unless
it has been specified explicitly. Turn this flag off to allow for
JtaTransactionManager operating against the TransactionManager only,
despite a default UserTransaction being available.
items.translation: 默认为"true"，除非显式指定，否则自动检测 UserTransaction。若要允许 JtaTransactionManager 仅针对 TransactionManager 运行（即使默认存在 UserTransaction），请关闭此标志。

items.source:
Default is "true": UserTransaction lookup will only happen at startup,
reusing the same UserTransaction handle for all transactions of all threads.
This is the most efficient choice for all application servers that provide
a shared UserTransaction object (the typical case).
items.translation: 默认为"true"：UserTransaction 查找仅在启动时进行，所有线程的所有事务将复用同一个 UserTransaction 句柄。这是所有提供共享 UserTransaction 对象的应用服务器（典型情况）最高效的选择。

items.source:
Turn this flag off to enforce a fresh lookup of the UserTransaction
for every transaction. This is only necessary for application servers
that return a new UserTransaction for every transaction, keeping state
tied to the UserTransaction object itself rather than the current thread.
items.translation: 关闭此标志可强制为每个事务执行新的 UserTransaction 查找。仅对于返回新 UserTransaction 的应用服务器（将状态绑定到 UserTransaction 对象本身而非当前线程）才需要这样做。

items.source:
Default is "true", autodetecting the TransactionManager unless it has been
specified explicitly. Can be turned off to deliberately ignore an available
TransactionManager, for example when there are known issues with suspend/resume
and any attempt to use REQUIRES_NEW or NOT_SUPPORTED should fail fast.
items.translation: 默认为"true"，除非显式指定，否则自动检测 TransactionManager。可以将其关闭以故意忽略可用的 TransactionManager，例如当已知存在挂起/恢复问题且任何尝试使用 REQUIRES_NEW 或 NOT_SUPPORTED 都应快速失败时。

items.source:
A TransactionSynchronizationRegistry allows for interposed registration
of transaction synchronizations, as an alternative to the regular registration
methods on the JTA TransactionManager API. Also, it is an official part of the
Jakarta EE platform, in contrast to the JTA TransactionManager itself.
items.translation: TransactionSynchronizationRegistry 允许以 JTA TransactionManager API 上的常规注册方法作为替代的方式，进行事务同步的中间注册。此外，它也是 Jakarta EE 平台的官方组成部分，而 JTA TransactionManager 本身则不是。

items.source:
Note that the TransactionSynchronizationRegistry will be autodetected in JNDI and
also from the UserTransaction/TransactionManager object if implemented there as well.
items.translation: 请注意，事务同步注册表（TransactionSynchronizationRegistry）将在 JNDI 中自动检测，如果在该对象中也实现了用户事务（UserTransaction）/事务管理器（TransactionManager），则也会从该对象中进行检测。

items.source:
Note that the TransactionSynchronizationRegistry will be autodetected
at the Jakarta EE default location "java:comp/TransactionSynchronizationRegistry"
if not specified explicitly.
items.translation: 请注意，如果未显式指定，TransactionSynchronizationRegistry 将在 Jakarta EE 默认位置 "java:comp/TransactionSynchronizationRegistry" 处被自动检测。

items.source:
Default is "true", autodetecting the TransactionSynchronizationRegistry
unless it has been specified explicitly. Can be turned off to delegate
synchronization registration to the regular JTA TransactionManager API.
items.translation: 默认为"true"，除非已明确指定，否则将自动检测 TransactionSynchronizationRegistry。可将其关闭以将同步注册委托给常规的 JTA TransactionManager API。

items.source:
Default is "false", throwing an exception if a non-default isolation level
is specified for a transaction. Turn this flag on if affected resource adapters
check the thread-bound transaction context and apply the specified isolation
levels individually (for example, through an IsolationLevelDataSourceAdapter).
items.translation: 默认值为 "false"，如果为事务指定了非默认隔离级别，则抛出异常。如果受影响的资源适配器检查线程绑定的事务上下文并单独应用指定的隔离级别（例如，通过 IsolationLevelDataSourceAdapter），请打开此标志。

items.source: Can be overridden in subclasses to provide a different TransactionManager object.
items.translation: 可在子类中重写以提供不同的 TransactionManager 对象。

items.source:
The UserTransaction object will either be looked up freshly for the
current transaction, or the cached one looked up at startup will be used.
The latter is the default: Most application servers use a shared singleton
UserTransaction that can be cached. Turn off the "cacheUserTransaction"
flag to enforce a fresh lookup for every transaction.
items.translation: `UserTransaction` 对象将针对当前事务进行新的查找，或者使用启动时缓存的实例。后者是默认行为：大多数应用服务器使用可缓存的共享单例 `UserTransaction`。若要强制为每个事务执行新的查找，请关闭 `"cacheUserTransaction"` 标志。

items.source:
Subclasses can override this to provide a JtaTransactionObject
subclass, for example holding some additional JTA handle needed.
items.translation: 子类可以重写此方法以提供一个 `JtaTransactionObject` 子类，例如持有某些额外的 JTA 句柄。

items.source:
This implementation only supports standard JTA functionality:
that is, no per-transaction isolation levels and no transaction names.
Can be overridden in subclasses, for specific JTA implementations.
items.translation: 此实现仅支持标准 JTA 功能：即不支持每事务隔离级别和事务名称。可在子类中重写，以支持特定的 JTA 实现。

items.source:
The default implementation throws a TransactionSuspensionNotSupportedException,
assuming that transaction suspension is generally not supported.
items.translation: 默认实现会抛出 `TransactionSuspensionNotSupportedException`，假定事务挂起通常不受支持。

items.source:
Invoked when the control of the Spring transaction manager and thus all Spring
transaction synchronizations end, without the transaction being completed yet. This
is for example the case when participating in an existing JTA or EJB CMT transaction.
items.translation: 在 Spring 事务管理器以及所有 Spring 事务同步结束但事务尚未完成时被调用。例如，当参与现有的 JTA 或 EJB CMT 事务时就会出现这种情况。

items.source:
The default implementation registers the synchronizations on the
JTA 1.1 TransactionSynchronizationRegistry, if available, or on the
JTA TransactionManager's current Transaction - again, if available.
If none of the two is available, a warning will be logged.
items.translation: 默认实现会在可用的情况下，将同步注册到 JTA 1.1 的 `TransactionSynchronizationRegistry` 上，或者注册到 JTA `TransactionManager` 的当前 `Transaction` 上。如果两者均不可用，将记录警告信息。

items.source: Create a new JtaTransactionManager instance, to be configured as bean. Invoke afterPropertiesSet to activate the configuration.
items.translation: 创建一个新的 `JtaTransactionManager` 实例，并将其配置为 Bean。调用 `afterPropertiesSet` 以激活该配置。

items.source: Apply the given transaction timeout. The default implementation will call UserTransaction.setTransactionTimeout for a non-default timeout value.
items.translation: 应用给定的事务超时时间。对于非默认超时值，默认实现将调用 `UserTransaction.setTransactionTimeout`。

items.source: Build a UserTransaction handle based on the given TransactionManager.
items.translation: 基于给定的 TransactionManager 构建 UserTransaction 句柄。

items.source:
Check the UserTransaction as well as the TransactionManager handle,
assuming standard JTA requirements.
items.translation: 同时检查 UserTransaction 和 TransactionManager 句柄，假设满足标准的 JTA 要求。

items.source: Create an active Transaction object based on the given name and timeout.
items.translation: 根据给定的名称和超时时间创建活动的 Transaction 对象。

items.source:
Find the JTA TransactionManager through autodetection: checking whether the
UserTransaction object implements the TransactionManager, and checking the
fallback JNDI locations.
items.translation: 通过自动检测查找 JTA TransactionManager：检查 UserTransaction 对象是否实现了 TransactionManager，并检查回退的 JNDI 位置。

items.source:
Find the JTA UserTransaction through a default JNDI lookup:
"java:comp/UserTransaction".
items.translation: 通过默认 JNDI 查找获取 JTA UserTransaction："java:comp/UserTransaction"。

items.source: Return the JNDI environment to use for JNDI lookups.
items.translation: 返回用于 JNDI 查找的 JNDI 环境。

items.source: Return the JndiTemplate used for JNDI lookups.
items.translation: 返回用于 JNDI 查找的 JndiTemplate。

items.source: Return the JTA TransactionManager that this transaction manager uses, if any.
items.translation: 返回此事务管理器使用的 JTA TransactionManager（如果有）。

items.source: Return the JTA 1.1 TransactionSynchronizationRegistry that this transaction manager uses, if any.
items.translation: 返回此事务管理器使用的 JTA 1.1 TransactionSynchronizationRegistry（如果有）。

items.source: Return the JTA UserTransaction that this transaction manager uses.
items.translation: 返回此事务管理器使用的 JTA UserTransaction。

items.source:
This implementation returns "true": a JTA commit will properly handle
transactions that have been marked rollback-only at a global level.
items.translation: 此实现返回"true"：JTA 提交将正确处理在整体级别上已标记为仅回滚的事务。

items.source:
Default JNDI location for the JTA UserTransaction. Many Jakarta EE servers
also provide support for the JTA TransactionManager interface there.
items.translation: JTA UserTransaction 的默认 JNDI 位置。许多 Jakarta EE 服务器也在此处提供对 JTA TransactionManager 接口的支持。

items.source:
Fallback JNDI locations for the JTA TransactionManager. Applied if
the JTA UserTransaction does not implement the JTA TransactionManager
interface, provided that the "autodetectTransactionManager" flag is "true".
items.translation: JTA TransactionManager 的备用 JNDI 位置。如果 JTA UserTransaction 未实现 JTA TransactionManager 接口，且“autodetectTransactionManager”标志为“true”，则应用这些位置。

items.source:
Standard Jakarta EE JNDI location for the JTA TransactionSynchronizationRegistry.
Autodetected when available.
items.translation:
Jakarta EE 中 JTA TransactionSynchronizationRegistry 的标准 JNDI 位置。
在可用时会自动检测。

items.source:
Set the JndiTemplate to use for JNDI lookups.
A default one is used if not set.
items.translation: 设置用于 JNDI 查找的 JndiTemplate。如果未设置，则使用默认值。

items.source:
Set the JNDI environment to use for JNDI lookups.
Creates a JndiTemplate with the given environment settings.
items.translation: 设置用于 JNDI 查找的 JNDI 环境。使用给定的环境设置创建 JndiTemplate。

items.source: Called after doCommit and doRollback execution, on any outcome. The default implementation does nothing.
items.translation: 在 `doCommit` 和 `doRollback` 执行后，无论结果如何都会调用。默认实现什么都不做。

items.source: The default implementation returns false, assuming that participating in existing transactions is generally not supported. Subclasses are of course encouraged to provide such support.
items.translation: 默认实现返回 `false`，假设通常不支持参与现有事务。当然鼓励子类提供此类支持。

items.source: A special scenario is a nested transaction without savepoint: If useSavepointForNestedTransaction() returns "false", this method will be called to start a nested transaction when necessary. In such a context, there will be an active transaction: The implementation of this method has to detect this and start an appropriate nested transaction.
items.translation: 特殊场景是指不带保存点的嵌套事务：如果useSavepointForNestedTransaction()返回"false"，则会在必要时调用此方法以启动嵌套事务。在此类上下文中，将存在一个活动事务：此方法的实现必须检测这一点并启动适当的嵌套事务。

items.source:
The result will be evaluated according to the specified propagation
behavior for the new transaction. An existing transaction might get
suspended (in case of PROPAGATION_REQUIRES_NEW), or the new transaction
might participate in the existing one (in case of PROPAGATION_REQUIRED).
items.translation: 结果将根据新事务指定的传播行为进行评估。现有事务可能会被挂起（在 PROPAGATION_REQUIRES_NEW 的情况下），或者新事务可能会参与现有事务（在 PROPAGATION_REQUIRED 的情况下）。

items.source:
This method gets called when the transaction manager has decided to actually
start a new transaction. Either there wasn't any transaction before, or the
previous transaction has been suspended.
items.translation: 此方法在事务管理器决定实际开始一个新事务时被调用。要么之前没有事务，要么之前的交易已被挂起。

items.source:
An implementation does not need to check the "new transaction" flag
or the rollback-only flag; this will already have been handled before.
Usually, a straight commit will be performed on the transaction object
contained in the passed-in status.
items.translation: 实现无需检查“新事务”标志或回滚专用标志；这些在此之前已经处理过。通常，将在传入状态中包含的事务对象上执行直接提交。
实现无需检查“新事务”标志；该标志此前已处理。通常，将对传入状态中包含的事务对象执行直接回滚。

items.source:
The default implementation throws an IllegalTransactionStateException,
assuming that participating in existing transactions is generally not
supported. Subclasses are of course encouraged to provide such support.
items.translation: 默认实现会抛出 `IllegalTransactionStateException`，假定参与现有事务通常不受支持。当然，鼓励子类提供此类支持。

items.source: Should not throw any exceptions but just issue warnings on errors.
items.translation: 不应抛出任何异常，而应在出错时仅发出警告。

items.source: Register a JTA synchronization on the JTA TransactionManager, for calling afterCompletion on the given Spring TransactionSynchronizations.
items.translation: 在 JTA TransactionManager 上注册一个 JTA 同步，以便在给定的 Spring TransactionSynchronizations 上调用 `afterCompletion`。
